scope: The eight src/apps/* CLI front-ends named as next by M36. Contract checks against OpenSSL 3.6.4 for argument-string lifetimes, file/BIO ownership on every exit, option-array bounds, error tails, allocation arithmetic, and getter-returned or body-owned raw pointers; one verification defect, one incomplete stdin transcription and one wrong-format option fallback repaired.
worktree: source: src/apps/req.rs and src/apps/rsa.rs repaired; src/apps/{pkeyparam,pkey,prime,rand,sess_id,skeyutl}.rs audited with no source change. queue/receipt: REMAINING-AUDIT.txt, AUDITED-FILES.txt, PERFILE-INDEX.md section 41 and this file.

reconciliation.method: AUDITED-FILES.txt is the union of each mechanism sweep's structured .files array, the M1 files, the structured per-file records and each boundary sweep's structured boundaries. The eight files added here were absent from the pre-batch file (they were the first eight entries of REMAINING-AUDIT.txt) and were inserted in the file's existing sorted order.
reconciliation.difference_from_333: M36 left 333 audited / 430 unaudited. This batch moves the eight files it named as next; no skipped boundary was removed from the remaining queue.

file_dispositions.note: inbio and out are released once on every return; the -check valid arm keeps the context live until after the write; BIO_write's length is the 21-byte literal.

mechanisms: PEM/DER private and public key writers
file_dispositions.note: pkey and out are released once on every exit; the -ec_conv_form/-ec_param_enc arm frees both before refusing; private is retained only for the shared permission divergence.

BIO_get_line writes at most BUFSIZE-1 bytes and NUL-terminates, so hex_digit_prefix stops at index BUFSIZE-1 and buf[n] = 0 is in bounds; the BN_bn2hex/BN_bn2dec block is one adopted allocation with the OPENSSL_free seam at (NULL, 0).

chunk <= 1<<16 and hex.len() <= 1<<17 fit the c_int write count; scaled_num is bounded by UINT64_MAX >> 3 before the loop; the base64 chain is released once by BIO_free_all. Matches OpenSSL 3.6.4 (no -n option).

mechanisms: load_csr BIO ownership and stdin arm
file_dispositions.note: A NULL X509_REQ_get0_pubkey skipped -verify and could exit 0; it now follows the authority and exits 1. load_csr now opens a NULL filename as stdin through keyio::bio_open_default, as load_csr_autofmt does. req/out are released once on every return.

-RSAPublicKey_in set pubin = 2 but keyio::load_pubkey has no PKCS#1 public-key arm, so it decoded a different format; the arm now reaches not_landed. pkey, out and ectx are released once on every exit.
peer is borrowed from x and used only while x is live; out is NULL when -noout suppresses printing and BIO_free_all(NULL) is the authority's no-op; x/out are released once on every return.
cstr never retains a getter pointer past the call; skey is NULL-or-live before the single EVP_SKEY_free; mgmt is released after skey; the stderr BIO is NOCLOSE and freed once per arm.

defects.detail: A NULL X509_REQ_get0_pubkey skipped the -verify arm entirely, so -verify -noout could return 0 without verifying. The authority's apps/req.c:974-976 goes to end with ret=1; the guard now does the same.
load_csr refused a NULL filename instead of reading stdin as load_csr_autofmt does; it now opens through keyio::bio_open_default.

-RSAPublicKey_in mapped to FORMAT_PEM/ASN1 in this stratum, whose load_pubkey decodes SubjectPublicKeyInfo; the authority maps it to FORMAT_PEMRSA/FORMAT_ASN1RSA. The arm now reaches not_landed rather than accepting a different format.
